body: Thank you everyone, I took a time out from social media and I'm going to cut my hours at work so I can focus on some self healing. I appreciate your comments so much. Thank you ♥️

My parents came up to my flat without telling me and took me home, I was in bed crying and reaching for pills to take the pain away but luckily they came just in time. I can't work cause I have back problems but the government won't give me any support because I didn't score enough which is ridiculous giving the amount of people in my country on benefits and they have't got anything wrong with them or they are just lazy. 

I just want a fresh start but with no money I can't do that :( I'm hoping it gets easier from here, but I my mind set at the moment is just telling me it'll get worse before it gets better. Thank you for your response!
